decisions.reason: As a door lever handle family that remained in the catalogue after launch, it likely fits the firm's core architectural hardware range and would usually be kept unless sales were clearly weak.

A door handle design still shown one year after launch is likely a viable design-led variant in a long-life product category, though individual designs face somewhat higher assortment rationalisation risk than core families.

The electronic access system appears to be an actively marketed innovation with a refined 2019 naming, so despite faster technology turnover it is strategically important enough to keep rather than withdraw.
